Race rules

Complete the course and cross the gate. Track quality falls with off-road travel. Ranked time = elapsed time + 0.02 × (100 − quality)² seconds.

Track
TUNING

READY— FPS

W accelerates. Space brakes. A and D steer. Escape pauses. On touch screens, drag the steering wheel and hold the gas or brake pedal. Hold R for a new race, or tap the new race button on touch screens. If the car rolls over, tap R or use the Right the car button that appears next to the car chooser. The edges are connected. Every car has a gear stick. The Supercar is a manual with five gears and reverse under fifth: Q shifts down and E shifts up, and Q in first gear selects reverse when the car is stopped. The other cars are automatics with Park, Reverse, Neutral and Drive; they start in Drive, Q moves the stick down toward Drive and E moves it up toward Park. Reverse and Park only engage when the car is stopped. You can also drag the stick's knob through its gate (on the focused stick, the arrow keys move it, and 1 to 5 pick a gear on the Supercar). The Drone flies with two sticks, like a real drone's remote in Mode 2. The left stick (W and S, A and D) climbs, descends and turns on the spot; the right stick (the arrow keys) tilts the drone to fly forward, back, left and right. Let go and it levels out, holds its height and drifts to a stop. On touch screens, drag the two sticks. The same instructions are painted on the ground.
